variety_description: Tarangini, also known as MTU-1156, is a high yielding, medium maturity,  long slender, tall variety released in 2016 by RARS, Maruteru. Widely recommended for medium fertility areas in wet season and in irrigated areas in dry season.  Besides having high yield potential, this variety has distinct advantages of high HRR, non-lodging, low shattering and tolerant to major diseases and insect pests.
